forward_plan: Launch CAD only through cad_engine.main:app; replace manual executable versions with automatic build identity; migrate internal compatibility modules incrementally without changing approved semantics.
rollback_plan: Redeploy the preceding Git commit or approved release tag. Never restore a copied runtime-version file as a production entrypoint.
data_validation: Build identity hashes and schema revisions are contract-tested; stored PMM v2 remains readable.
compatibility_order: retire internal legacy modules only after focused and golden parity
deprecation_window: Internal version-named modules are non-entrypoint compatibility debt and may remain only while listed by the audit; no new ones are allowed.
